answer: Require each new agent identity to post a bond that is forfeited if it fails a randomly assigned task verified by independent agents with established reputations. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital behind every identity, then risks losing each bond when fabricated agents cannot produce consistent work or corroborate one another. The vine of linked accounts offers no discount: an oasis of fake reputations still requires separate collateral, while a sparrow-sized attacker can afford only a few identities at a time.
